name: India Finsec Limited
about: India Finsec Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in loan and investment activities in India. The company offers financial services, such as Inter Corporate Deposits, advancing Short term loans, Long term loans, credits to individuals and companies, and other services. It also deals in stocks, shares, and securities. The company serves individuals and companies. India Finsec Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in New Delhi, India.
